subject: CriticalPath: throughput spike follow-through and stability inspection
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gildedretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@gildedretail.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Major throughput spike impacting checkout (need exec attention)

Naomi,

We saw a sustained throughput spike on 2028-09-17 21:00 UTC that doubled our token processing time and caused ~18% of checkouts to time out. This hit our peak window and caused a material revenue impact during the promotion. We've already opened a bridge and captured traces, but procurement needs an executive readout and an actionable mitigation plan from Redwood by end of week.

Key asks:
- A concise RCA and immediate mitigations we can apply by Thursday EOD PST.
- Clear owner and timeline for rollback/fallback options.
- Any credits or SLA remediation you can commit to.

Attachments: sample_traces-0917.zip (reference)

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Head of Infrastructure
GildedRetail Inc
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gildedretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Sep 2028 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Major throughput spike impacting checkout (need exec attention)

Asha — thanks for the heads up and the traces. I'm pulling together the triage notes and will own the customer-facing RCA. Karthik will lead the mitigation engineering; Grace will coordinate escalation and credit conversations.

Immediate steps we're taking today:
- Night shift runbook: force-prefetch disabled and request-routing bias applied to route heavy sessions to protected capacity (rolling now).
- Collecting expanded KV-cache and batching histograms (we have a first pass).
- Engaging infra partner to check for transient NVLink contention on the cluster running your model variant.

I'll send a draft RCA + action tracker within 24 hours. If you need a quick sync before that, we can jump on a 30-min bridge tomorrow morning.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@gildedretail.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Sep 2028 09:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Major throughput spike impacting checkout (need exec attention)

Team — quick engineering readout (summary of technical findings so far):

1) Root trigger: a synchronous batch of long-sequence reproduction requests from a vendor integration increased average sequence length from 350 to ~1,900 tokens for ~27 minutes UTC. That amplified KV-cache pressure and pushed several pods into continuous recompile fallback paths (we observed 2.3x per-token CPU overhead).

2) Secondary failure: our adaptive batching heuristic misclassified the incoming distribution and increased batch sizes; combined with cache misses, this produced head-of-line blocking and increased tail latency.

3) Observed impact: 18% increase in 95/99 latency; error-rate spike to 6% tied to timeout policy at the load balancer; throughput degradation affected two AZs running the customer's dedicated capacity pool.

Temporary mitigations applied (and status):
- Routing isolation to spare pool (applied 2028-09-18 23:10 UTC) — mitigated tail for ~60% of traffic.
- Immediate patch: re-tune adaptive-batcher thresholds (deployed canary 03:40 UTC) — reduced head-of-line by 40%.
- Rollback candidate: pin to cached-only KV mode for critical checkout routes (manual toggle available; needs customer sign-off).

Next engineering actions:
- Deliver full RCA doc and actionable playbook by 2028-09-19 17:00 PST (I've got a draft).
- Follow-up: we recommend a staged rollout of pinned cached-only mode for checkout route, coordinated with GildedRetail traffic hours.

I'll attach the draft RCA and the action-tracker workbook for owners and timeline.

— Karthik
Director, Serving Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 20280919-criticalpath-rca-draft.pdf; criticalpath-action-tracker.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gildedretail.com>, Ops Team <ops@gildedretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Sep 2028 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: CriticalPath RCA and proposed remediation timeline (draft)

Asha / GildedRetail ops — please find attached the draft RCA and our proposed remediation timeline. Executive summary: a combination of an unexpected long-sequence traffic burst and an adaptive-batching misclassification caused cache pressure and head-of-line blocking that increased latency and timeouts.

Proposed customer-facing actions (high level):
- Immediate (within 48h): toggle pinned cached-only mode on checkout routes during peak promotions (requires a 1-hour planned window with customer ops). Owner: Karthik (Redwood) / Asha (GildedRetail).
- Near term (1 week): deploy a conservative adaptive-batching profile for retail checkout traffic and add sequence-length gating. Owner: Karthik / Redwood serving team.
- Medium term (4 weeks): add traffic-aware autoscaling rule on dedicated pools and implement NVLink contention telemetry to the console. Owner: Infra / Platform.
- Credits/Remediation: we propose a credit equal to one week of standard hosted per-token charges for the affected capacity during the incident window; Grace will coordinate details.

We've also included a runbook for rollback and a tested validation checklist. Can we schedule an executive 30-min readout Thursday 2028-09-20 09:30 PST? If that's not workable, propose an alternate.

Best,
Naomi
From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gildedretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@gildedretail.com>, Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@procureco.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Sep 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CriticalPath RCA and proposed remediation timeline (draft)

Thanks Naomi and team — the RCA draft is clear and the remediation path is reasonable. We're green to proceed with the immediate toggle during the maintenance window on Saturday 2028-09-22 02:00 UTC (Asha + Ops will coordinate).

Two exec asks before we sign off:
1) Can Redwood commit to a validated rollback within 30 minutes if we see instability post-toggle? We need an explicit SLA for the rollback window in the project playbook.
2) Can you confirm the credit proposal and provide the mechanics for how that will surface on our invoice?

We'll join the Thursday exec readout and will bring legal/finance if needed for the credit mechanics.

On phone if anything urgent.

— Asha
Head of Infrastructure, GildedRetail Inc
